chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah from someone else from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about making up for the month of Ramadan during Dhu al-Hijjah, or can I cut it piece-meal? He (peace be upon him) said: Make it up in Dhu al-Hijjah, and cut it if you wish.

key_terms.أَقْطَعُهُ: To cut or break the fasts into separate, non-consecutive days
key_terms.ذِي الْحِجَّةِ: Dhu al-Hijjah, the tenth month of the Islamic lunar calendar
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: Making up for missed obligatory acts of worship

ai.seo_question: Can I make up missed Ramadan fasts in Dhu al-Hijjah, and must I do them continuously?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the flexibility in fulfilling Qada fasts during Dhu al-Hijjah, a period often associated with the sacred months and Hajj. The Imam’s permission to either complete the fasts continuously or 'cut' (interrupt) them highlights the practical ease granted to believers, distinguishing this ruling from the stricter prohibition of fasting during the days of Tashriq. This reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle of facilitating religious obligations without imposing undue hardship.

en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from someone else, from Aban, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about making up for a Month of Ramazan during Zil Hijja, or can I cut it piece-meal?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Make up for it in Zil Hijja, and cut it if you so desire to’.
en.sarwar: 5. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from more than one person from Aban from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu ‘Abd Allah who has said the following:

“This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about making Qada’ (compensatory fast) of fast of the month of Ramadan in the month of Dhul al-Hajjah and to discontinue it. He (the Imam) said, ‘You can make its Qada’ (compensatory fast) in Dhul al-Hajjah and discontinue if you like.’”
